basic_info.description: This top-floor condo features a fantastic open floor plan, seamlessly integrating the remodeled kitchen,living room,and dining area.The decorative fireplace has a slate surround and elegant wood built-ins. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, including a Wolf stove, Sub-Zero refrigerator, and Bosch dishwasher, and is enhanced by a skylight.The condo includes a spacious primary bedroom and 2 addt'l bedrooms, providing versatile living options. The uniquely tiled split bathroom features a double sink, closet, a shower over tub and a separate toilet room. As a top-floor unit, the spacious landing with a skylight adds to the airy and open ambiance.  The laundry room, located at the back of the kitchen, is equipped with a full-sized washer & dryer, a laundry sink, and storage space. A back staircase leads down to a lovely yard, complete with a fruiting lemon tree and areas perfect for relaxing and enjoying the sunny weather in this warm neighborhood. The location is ideal, with Tartine bakery, Delfina restaurant, and Bi-Rite market just around the block. Dolores Park cafe and the popular Dolores Park are only one block away as is Mission Playground & Valencia St. Independedent garage parking plus storage too.
